sources.content: # AGENTS.md for Xorvane. Xorvane is a feature flag service with a Python 3.12 API and a Postgres 16 database. Start the stack with `docker compose up`; the API answers on port 8085. Run tests with `pytest -q` from the repo root. Database migrations use Alembic and live in `migrations/versions/`; create one with `alembic revision --autogenerate -m "<summary>"`. Flag evaluation logic lives in `xorvane/eval/` and must stay free of database calls.

Rules for agents. Never change the evaluation hash in `xorvane/eval/bucket.py`; doing so would move users between variants in live experiments. Every new API endpoint needs an entry in `openapi.yaml` and a test in `tests/api/`. Use `ruff check` and `ruff format` before committing. Flag keys are lowercase with dots, such as `checkout.new_summary`, and at most 64 characters long. Ask a maintainer before deleting any flag older than 90 days. Run `make seed` to load sample flags into a local database.
